odia: ଏତେ ଖାଇ ନ ପୂରିଲା ପେଟ ବିରି ଓଳିଆରେ ମାରୁଛ ହାତ
title: Still reaching for the pulse store
literal_meaning: After eating so much, the belly is still not full; you are reaching into the stored black gram.
explanation: The speaker points out a comic excess: even a substantial meal has not stopped the hand reaching for more. The dictionary places the line under having a full meal; the appetite and the reaching hand are its concrete scene. It can be read as a teasing complaint that someone has already had plenty yet still wants another share. That broader application is an editorial reading, not an additional dictionary gloss. Tone matters: the joke need not be turned into a judgment about a person’s body or genuine hunger.
meaning_odia: ଏତେ ଖାଇସାରି ମଧ୍ୟ ପେଟ ପୂରିଲା ନାହିଁ, ହାତ ପୁଣି ବିରି ରଖାଥିବା ଓଳିଆ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଯାଉଛି—ଏହି ବଢ଼ିଚାଲିଥିବା ଚାହିଦାରେ କଥାଟିର ଖୋଚା। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ଭୋଜନରେ ପେଟ ପୂରିବା ଅର୍ଥର ଉଦାହରଣ। ନିଜ ଭାଗରେ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ପାଇସାରି ଆହୁରି ମାଗୁଥିବା ଜଣକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ଧରି ଥଟ୍ଟା କରାଯାଇପାରେ; ଏହା ଆମର ପ୍ରୟୋଗମୂଳକ ପାଠ। ହସରେ କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା କଥା ଯେପରି କାହାର ପ୍ରକୃତ ଭୋକ କିମ୍ବା ଶରୀରକୁ ଅପମାନ ନକରେ, ସେଥିରେ କହିବାର ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ଫରକ ଅଛି।
english_summary: A reaching hand makes a teasing picture of wanting more after already having plenty.
odia_summary: ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ପାଇସାରି ମଧ୍ୟ ଆହୁରି ଚାହିଁବାକୁ ଖୋଚା ଦିଏ ଏହି ଭୋଜନର ଚିତ୍ର।
usage_example: Original imagined example: At a drawing club, everyone receives a packet of paper. One member has already taken two spare packets and now reaches for the last one. A friend laughs and quotes the saying, asking them to leave something for the others. The joke concerns their extra share, not their appetite or body.
cultural_context: The food image is retained as a conversational tease. The source supplies the literal full-meal sense, not a general moral definition. The storage object is retained as ଓଳିଆ in Odia; its construction has not been independently established here.
